name: Denial of Service
Description: An attack that floods the drone's communication links, flight controller, or companion computer with excessive network packets, exhausting bandwidth and computing resources.
Symptoms: High packet loss rates or extreme latency on the control and telemetry link
Repeated heartbeat packet losses or control link disconnection warnings
Onboard CPU and RAM utilization spiked to near 100%
Impact: Renders the operator unable to control the drone, receive telemetry, or trigger manual override procedures, potentially leading to a fly-away or crash if failsafes fail to engage.
Recommended Action: Enable rate-limiting for packets on the receiver interface. Automatically activate the Return-To-Home (RTH) autonomous route on the flight controller. Filter out suspected attacker source addresses.
